title: Kissed with Mediterranean Flavors Slovakian Farfalle Lasagna
description: A unique Slovakian dish featuring farfalle pasta, layered with Mediterranean flavors and a crispy puff pastry crust.
instructions: Cook the farfalle pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tbsp of olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the ground lamb to the skillet, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks. Cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the tomato paste to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in the chopped parsley and cook for an additional 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked farfalle pasta, lamb mixture, and crumbled feta cheese. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Place the pastry on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Spread the pasta mixture evenly over the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Top the pasta mixture with the shredded mozzarella cheese.
Fold the 1-inch border of the pastry up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the pastry with the remaining 2 tbsp of olive oil and bake for 25-30 minutes, until golden brown.
